CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2423 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 58dbe46a0eff6d217378ecd3bccc331eb20867a1. Bus nonce: ea5bcafd577125d7e6ea134fa9b354f5. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly; this round's reviewer measures with the finder's harness. Earlier rounds' verdicts are the PR's `Fix review:` comments: say which round this is. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 58dbe46a0eff6d217378ecd3bccc331eb20867a1`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: <merge|blocked> 58dbe46a0eff6d217378ecd3bccc331eb20867a1` for merge, or `Fix review: blocked 58dbe46a0eff6d217378ecd3bccc331eb20867a1 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets) for blocked, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: ea5bcafd577125d7e6ea134fa9b354f5`. Put the evidence in an `ev/` directory beside it, including `ev/HEAD` holding the 40-hex head you measured, under /tmp/seat/rev2423/. Do NOT run bus.sh: the dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, and the orchestrator publishes the verdict there. Return it on a probe ref, and push nothing else: `cd /tmp/seat/rev2423 && rm -rf pr && git init -q pr && cp -r verdict.md ev pr/ && git -C pr add -A && git -C pr -c user.name=hpo-seat -c user.email=hpo-seat@users.noreply.github.com commit -qm "verdict 2423 58dbe46a0eff6d217378ecd3bccc331eb20867a1" && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer fetch -q /tmp/seat/rev2423/pr HEAD && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer push -q origin FETCH_HEAD:refs/heads/probe/rev-2423-ea5bcafd`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except that probe ref. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in the verdict instead.

Context for this PR: it is the hotfix for main's wave-script red. Its own wave-script run is red only because the job restores tools/policy readers from the base (07a09406), which grade main's history and print the 2 known DIVERGENT lines (#2401, #2379). tvofi authorised an admin merge for that red alone. Verify adversarially that (a) the head's own readers give 0 divergent on origin/main history, (b) every other required check is green at the head, (c) the new merge-subject guard accepts GitHub's default subject for this PR's own merge commit (simulate it) and refuses custom ones, and (d) no check was weakened. Any other red means blocked.
